Q435.reason: A sworn affidavit is an out-of-court statement offered for its truth and fits no hearsay exception, while the family Bible entry, portrait, and duplicate birth certificate fall under family-history or duplicate rules.

Q422.reason: Under federal conspiracy law (as in Feola) the government need only show intent to commit the underlying prohibited act, not knowledge of jurisdictional circumstances like the federal park location.

Q921.reason: The robbery and burglary were complete when the man left, so the heart attack occurred after the felonies ended and cannot ground felony murder.
